text: {"lessons":["My account has risen overall, but the decline in Period 6 and later dip remind me that monthly gains are not guaranteed; I should keep enough stability for retirement needs.","Selling some Stock A and Stock D at gains realized cash, but I should base future trades on my plan and risk—not assume a winning stock must be sold or that gains will continue.","I have often held rather than traded, which suits my cautious approach; I should continue to avoid frequent moves and keep the account diversified."]}
